ns2:section.sectionText: Community Development in North Champaign is designed for upper-level undergraduate students who have an interest in developing their research skills to create social change. We will partner with Community groups in North Champaign on projects they have identified as important to them. Students will work in interdisciplinary teams, building on the outcomes achieved in previous semesters working with the 5th and Hill and the North First Street groups. No prior knowledge of design, fine arts or urban planning is required.Students will present their work to the public in a required symposium. Restriction(s): Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
